selection_rule: Exact intersection of actual nonbaseline observation times in both studies; no interpolation or fabricated timepoints.
rounding_scope: 2021 published mean ratios printed to2decimal places; optimistic rounding interval only, not biological variability, SD, SEM or CI.
hypothesis: A/A0=max(0,1-d(t)/R)^2 with one nonnegative inward displacement function shared across studies and removal methods; no time-law restriction.
method: Invert every allowed area interval into a displacement interval at each shared time; test intersection. Bisection80iterations yields optimistic smallest maximum error for the inverse diagnostic only.
limitations: Nominal circular geometry assumption; actual per-eye diameters/curvature unresolved.
Experimental cohort means differ in species-matched but nonidentical injury/care/substrate context.
A failed intersection rejects this shared-front hypothesis under the declared observations/geometry; it does not identify a biological cause.
Inferred displacement and error bounds are inverse diagnostics on already-inspected data, never new independently validated predictions.
No parameter fitting to either published holdout or changed original simulation protocols.
